name: omniscient/omnireview
description: Omnireview: what customers say of an establishment elsewhere - its rating, its reviews, replying as the establishment, inviting a customer to review, the link to leave one - whoever hosts them: Google (omnireview/google), Tripadvisor (omnireview/tripadvisor), Trustpilot (omnireview/trustpilot), each platform's terms of display and caching declared; and its Symfony and Twig bridges, which always show the origin, the date and the link.

suggest.omnireview/google: Google: Places API (rating, reviews) and Business Profile API (all reviews, replying, for the owner)
suggest.omnireview/tripadvisor: Tripadvisor Content API: rating, reviews, the link to write one
suggest.omnireview/trustpilot: Trustpilot: TrustScore, reviews, replies and invitations
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnireview\Bridge\Symfony\OmnireviewBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnireview\Bridge\Symfony\OmnireviewBundle
suggest.twig/twig: With Twig: Omnireview\Bridge\Twig\OmnireviewExtension, omnireview_widget() and the others
suggest.symfony/cache-contracts: With Twig: what the functions show kept in a cache, within each platform's terms
